notes.title: Vicious Cycle has a release date!
notes.notes: [p]Vicious Cycle finally has a release date, which is...[b]September 17th![/b] [/p][p][/p][p]I've been working on feverishly on new content for the final game for a while and I'm happy to finally show it all off. In fact, there's so much content that it could fill a shiny [b]new trailer![/b][/p][previewyoutube="of1hvz8QOw4;full"][/previewyoutube][p]I can't wait to see people experience Vicious Cycle. I hope you're looking forward to it too![/p]
